visual_audit_finding: 2026-08-22 sequential re-audit: the frozen Shot017 v1 chain repeated Shot016's raised-hand gesture in END and did not focus the recognition beat tightly enough on Ashe and the physical worn shield emblem. v2 uses the canonical local Ashe and female Byleth references, Shot016 v2 END, and the frozen Shot018 entry lane. START holds Ashe half-ready, KEY lands the emblem recognition with a softened bowstring, and the regenerated END lowers the bow nearly vertical with a visibly slack string before Ashe turns back toward Byleth. The performers are integrated into the same wet foggy ridge rather than pasted portrait plates.
required_revision: Keep monitor_required. Run prompt-against-frame QA and a 3-second motion probe; reject if Byleth becomes male or war-phase, Ashe fires or ages up, the bow remains taut in END, the shield emblem becomes text or a glowing icon, Shot016's stop-hand gesture repeats, Felix appears early, or Chinese/Mandarin/subtitles/UI/borders appear.
